# `array_compact`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Removes null values from the array.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array_compact(array)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_compact, example 1
> SELECT array_compact(array(1, 2, 3, null));
[1,2,3]
```

```sql
-- array_compact, example 2
> SELECT array_compact(array("a", "b", "c"));
["a","b","c"]
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
